ADDED i1: Verifies that {@link SpatialContextFactory#makeSpatialContext(Map, ClassLoader)} honours the custom configuration keys ("geo", "distCalculator", "worldBounds")
ADDED i2: System property the factory consults to pick a factory class; cleared after each test.
ADDED i3: Builds a {@link SpatialContext} from a flat list of alternating key/value strings, e.g. {@code makeContext("geo", "false", "distCalculator", "cartesian")}.
ADDED i4: geo=false alone => non-geo context with a default cartesian distance calculator.
ADDED i5: Custom squared-cartesian calculator plus explicit world bounds. worldBounds format is ENVELOPE(xMin, xMax, yMax, yMin) = ENVELOPE(-100, 75, 200, 0).
ADDED i6: RectangleImpl(minX, maxX, minY, maxY) = (-100, 75, 0, 200).
ADDED i7: geo=true with the law-of-cosines geodesic calculator.
